## 📋 Estructura Interna del Archivo

### Clases definidas:

#### Clase `Windows` (Línea 16)
- **Docstring:** _`MSDN on where to store app data files <https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/shell/knownfolderid>`_.

Makes use of the `appname <platformdirs.api.PlatformDirsABC.appname>`, `appauthor
<platformdirs.api.PlatformDirsABC.appauthor>`, `version <platformdirs.api.PlatformDirsABC.version>`, `roaming
<platformdirs.api.PlatformDirsABC.roaming>`, `opinion <platformdirs.api.PlatformDirsABC.opinion>`, `ensure_exists
<platformdirs.api.PlatformDirsABC.ensure_exists>`._
- **Métodos:**
  - `def user_data_dir(self)` (Línea 28): :return: data directory tied to the user, e.g.
 ``%USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\$appauthor\$appname`` (not roaming) or
 ``%USERPROFILE%\AppData\Roaming\$appauthor\$appname`` (roaming)
  - `def _append_parts(self, path)` (Línea 38): Sin docstring.
  - `def site_data_dir(self)` (Línea 54): :return: data directory shared by users, e.g. ``C:\ProgramData\$appauthor\$appname``
  - `def user_config_dir(self)` (Línea 60): :return: config directory tied to the user, same as `user_data_dir`
  - `def site_config_dir(self)` (Línea 65): :return: config directory shared by the users, same as `site_data_dir`
  - `def user_cache_dir(self)` (Línea 70): :return: cache directory tied to the user (if opinionated with ``Cache`` folder within ``$appname``) e.g.
 ``%USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\$appauthor\$appname\Cache\$version``
  - `def site_cache_dir(self)` (Línea 79): :return: cache directory shared by users, e.g. ``C:\ProgramData\$appauthor\$appname\Cache\$version``
  - `def user_state_dir(self)` (Línea 85): :return: state directory tied to the user, same as `user_data_dir`
  - `def user_log_dir(self)` (Línea 90): :return: log directory tied to the user, same as `user_data_dir` if not opinionated else ``Logs`` in it
  - `def user_documents_dir(self)` (Línea 99): :return: documents directory tied to the user e.g. ``%USERPROFILE%\Documents``
  - `def user_downloads_dir(self)` (Línea 104): :return: downloads directory tied to the user e.g. ``%USERPROFILE%\Downloads``
  - `def user_pictures_dir(self)` (Línea 109): :return: pictures directory tied to the user e.g. ``%USERPROFILE%\Pictures``
  - `def user_videos_dir(self)` (Línea 114): :return: videos directory tied to the user e.g. ``%USERPROFILE%\Videos``
  - `def user_music_dir(self)` (Línea 119): :return: music directory tied to the user e.g. ``%USERPROFILE%\Music``
  - `def user_desktop_dir(self)` (Línea 124): :return: desktop directory tied to the user, e.g. ``%USERPROFILE%\Desktop``
  - `def user_runtime_dir(self)` (Línea 129): :return: runtime directory tied to the user, e.g.
 ``%USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\Temp\$appauthor\$appname``
  - `def site_runtime_dir(self)` (Línea 138): :return: runtime directory shared by users, same as `user_runtime_dir`
